grh_cafd02b2c5fb9b60db77.title: Landslide
paragraphs: A spring storm drives Jerry Turner and Jack Wilson into Echo Caverns, where Jerry crawls into a newly discovered passage just before a rockslide seals the opening behind him. Dr. Christian leads a difficult river rescue through darkness, rough water and motor trouble, but the rescuers discover that the passage has shifted and Jerry is no longer where expected. Dr. Christian enters the cave and finds Jerry, only for another slide to cut them off together. Their escape finally comes through a hidden route known by a reclusive local who has long guarded the caverns secrets, explaining the mysterious lights seen around the cave and bringing the trapped men safely out.

The surviving recording runs about 29 minutes. The broadcast is also associated with [[org|org.b199d95f77b6c241|Vaseline]].
